admission.justification: Predicate and ordering tests pin the marking and the newest-first order with revert-verified failure; the obligation spans the writer predicate, the shared ordering helper and both surfaces in four files.

applicability: Every decision log surface: the task-page preview and the whole-log reader page.
conditions: Shared parsed-time descending order retains stable ties and places invalid stamps after valid stamps.
Product records count toward neither authored totals nor decision numbers; a records-only log remains reachable through the all-link.
The whole log expands authored text and rationale; records remain in their own counted end disclosure.
Exact legacy Finalize text and removed/skip-step prefixes still classify product records; authored collisions remain possible.
exclusions: Storage order carries no invariant; neither surface invents an order.
The stored decision shape is unchanged by the marking.

evidence: predicate tests + preview tests + whole-log unsorted test; pytest/vitest green

statement: Decision surfaces count and number authored decisions only: the preview shows the five newest by recorded time and its omitted-entry link names only the authored count; the whole log shows authored entries newest-first and retains product-written records unnumbered in a separate muted counted end disclosure. Product-record marking remains exact/prefix provenance classification, not enforced authorship separation.
